name: moe_fused_mul_sum
description: Weighted MoE reduction: out[t,h]=sum_k inputs[t,k,h]*topk_weights[t,k]*scale, where scale is routed_scaling_factor (1.0 if None). If expert_map is provided, slots with expert_map[topk_ids[t,k]]<0 are zeroed; otherwise if is_ep is True, slots with topk_ids[t,k]<0 are zeroed. Shapes: inputs [T,K,H], topk_weights [T,K], topk_ids [T,K] int32 or None, expert_map [E] int32 or None. Returns a new [T,H] tensor in inputs.dtype. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with K 2..8, H 128..4096, routed scaling, is_ep masking and expert_map masking.
